What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:

Our return policy applies to Dermalogica.com purchases only.

We accept returns for any reason within 30 days of your order date; the return process must be initiated within this period.
Return shipping, handling, and restocking fees are not charged when you use our prepaid label.
Only new or gently used items in original packaging are eligible. Items that are damaged from personal use, nearly empty, or tampered with/filled with other substances are not refundable.
Certain items are final sale and not returnable: partial kits or gift sets, free samples, gift-with-purchase items, and rewards items.
To return, visit our online returns center, enter your order number (begins with “S”) and zip code, select items, generate and print the prepaid UPS label, repackage with the packing slip, and drop it at UPS. Only returns traceable to our warehouse using our label will be credited.
If you don’t wish to keep an order that has already been processed/shipped, you can still return it through the returns center for a full refund of items marked for return once received.
Returned or canceled orders will reverse or decrease any loyalty points earned from that purchase and may adjust your rewards tier.
For orders paid with Afterpay or Klarna, the same Dermalogica return policy applies; you can also review their respective return/refund policies on their sites.
If you purchased from a salon, spa, or another website, you must contact them directly about their return policy.

In summary, you can return qualifying Dermalogica.com items within 30 days for a refund using our prepaid label, with some exclusions for final sale and non-eligible product conditions.
